courtroom_defense_counsel_not_in_data.description: The Courtroom's defense table has no measures of defense representation (federal defender, Criminal Justice Act panel lawyer or retained lawyer). The page says so plainly and shows sentencing outcomes and the civil pro se share instead.
courtroom_defense_counsel_not_in_data.reason: No lane acquired a district-level series on defense counsel type. Nothing is estimated in its place.

courtroom_reporter_not_in_data.description: The court reporter's seat has no statistics (court reporting and transcripts are not in any atlas source). The panel lists the atlas's own sources instead.
courtroom_reporter_not_in_data.reason: No public district-level series on court reporting was in scope.
